svg.title: Local Asset Studio: an illustrative local creation loop (animated)
svg.desc: Illustrative loop with example metrics: a recipe and role-tagged references lead to a route plan and resource checks, then ComfyUI runs the selected graph. An external GPU lease pauses new Studio generation; it is not a per-job capacity grant. Receipts retain available hashes, seeds and observations. Owner art acceptance and model licensing remain separate.
svg.text: illustrative route · example metrics · resource checks · receipt · owner review · licensing separate

g.text: trace · prompt 7f3c · owner can cancel this job only

svg.text: Pick a recipe and give each reference a role: identity, pose or style
The route plan is visible before you run it: model, LoRAs, VRAM estimate
Resource checks gate new work; an external GPU lease pauses Studio
ComfyUI runs the selected graph locally
Receipts keep available hashes, seeds and resource observations
A finished job is not art acceptance: the owner decides
Accepted assets may go to native tools; licensing stays separate
